targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * avg(e.passed::int), 1) AS "pass %" FROM runs r JOIN eval_results e ON e.run_id = r.id WHERE r.kind = 'eval' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND r.suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND e.tags && ARRAY[${area:sqlstring}]::text[] AND e.scenario IN (${scenario:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) AS runs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT e.passed) AS failed FROM runs r JOIN eval_results e ON e.run_id = r.id WHERE r.kind = 'eval' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND r.suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND e.tags && ARRAY[${area:sqlstring}]::text[] AND e.scenario IN (${scenario:sqlstring})

SELECT extract(epoch FROM max(r.started_at)) * 1000 AS "last run" FROM runs r JOIN eval_results e ON e.run_id = r.id WHERE r.kind = 'eval' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND r.suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND e.tags && ARRAY[${area:sqlstring}]::text[] AND e.scenario IN (${scenario:sqlstring})
SELECT coalesce(sum(cost_usd), 0) AS cost FROM runs r WHERE r.kind = 'eval' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring})

panels.title: Pass rate per run, by model

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.started_at AS time, r.model AS metric, round(100.0 * avg(e.passed::int), 1) AS pass FROM runs r JOIN eval_results e ON e.run_id = r.id WHERE r.kind = 'eval' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND r.suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND e.tags && ARRAY[${area:sqlstring}]::text[] AND e.scenario IN (${scenario:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Each point is one run of evals.run: the share of scenario runs that passed. Runs cover different areas, so filter by Area to compare like with like.

panels.title: Pass rate by area, by day

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', r.started_at) AS time, t.tag AS metric, round(100.0 * avg(e.passed::int), 1) AS pass FROM runs r JOIN eval_results e ON e.run_id = r.id CROSS JOIN unnest(e.tags) AS t(tag) WHERE r.kind = 'eval' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND r.suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND e.tags && ARRAY[${area:sqlstring}]::text[] AND e.scenario IN (${scenario:sqlstring}) AND t.tag IN (${area:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest result per scenario and model

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT e.scenario, r.model, r.suite, r.started_at, e.passed, e.tags,
         dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY e.scenario, r.model ORDER BY r.started_at DESC) AS rk
  FROM runs r JOIN eval_results e ON e.run_id = r.id WHERE r.kind = 'eval' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND r.suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND e.tags && ARRAY[${area:sqlstring}]::text[] AND e.scenario IN (${scenario:sqlstring})
)
SELECT scenario, model, suite, array_to_string(min(tags), ', ') AS area,
       max(started_at) FILTER (WHERE rk = 1) AS "last run",
       sum(passed::int) FILTER (WHERE rk = 1) || '/' || count(*) FILTER (WHERE rk = 1) AS latest,
       round(100.0 * avg(passed::int) FILTER (WHERE rk = 1)) AS "latest %",
       round(100.0 * avg(passed::int) FILTER (WHERE rk = 2)) AS "previous %",
       round(100.0 * avg(passed::int) FILTER (WHERE rk = 1)) - round(100.0 * avg(passed::int) FILTER (WHERE rk = 2)) AS change
FROM ranked GROUP BY scenario, model, suite ORDER BY "latest %", scenario

panels.description: The newest run of each scenario on each model, and the change from the run before it.

panels.title: Checks passed, by model

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.model,
  round(100.0 * avg(e.route_ok::int)) AS route, round(100.0 * avg(e.calls_ok::int)) AS calls,
  round(100.0 * avg(e.args_ok::int)) AS args, round(100.0 * avg(e.reply_ok::int)) AS reply,
  round(100.0 * avg(e.state_ok::int)) AS state
FROM runs r JOIN eval_results e ON e.run_id = r.id WHERE r.kind = 'eval' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND r.suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND e.tags && ARRAY[${area:sqlstring}]::text[] AND e.scenario IN (${scenario:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: route: the right path; calls: the right tools; args: their arguments; reply: what was said; state: what a live run left saved.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.started_at AS time, r.model AS metric, round(avg(e.seconds_p50)::numeric, 1) AS seconds FROM runs r JOIN eval_results e ON e.run_id = r.id WHERE r.kind = 'eval' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND r.suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND e.tags && ARRAY[${area:sqlstring}]::text[] AND e.scenario IN (${scenario:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Failures

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.started_at AS time, e.scenario, r.model, r.label AS run, r.suite, e.attempt,
  array_to_string(e.failures, E'\n') AS "failed checks", e.error,
  (SELECT string_agg('» ' || (t->>'say') || E'\n' || coalesce(t->>'reply', ''), E'\n') FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.turns) t) AS conversation,
  left(r.git_sha, 8) AS commit
FROM runs r JOIN eval_results e ON e.run_id = r.id WHERE r.kind = 'eval' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND r.suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}) AND e.tags && ARRAY[${area:sqlstring}]::text[] AND e.scenario IN (${scenario:sqlstring}) AND NOT e.passed ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, e.scenario LIMIT 300

panels.description: Every failing scenario run, newest first. Click a cell to read the whole conversation.
